title: Evaluate an integer expression in HolyC
prompt:
Use the TempleOS command line to evaluate (37 * 19) - (24 * 13) in HolyC.
Print the result with the exact label BENCH_ARITH= followed immediately by
the decimal integer and a newline. Leave that output visible and finish.
Execute the calculation in TempleOS; do not just type a precomputed answer.
